observed: Each direction independently fits covariance/source variance on opaque in-range pairs; residual comparisons clamp after applying each fitted transform. Gains are not reciprocal. All channels are unconstrained.
mathematical_interpretation: For identical paired samples under unconstrained ordinary least squares, forward_gain * reverse_gain equals squared correlation, not necessarily one. Here products around 0.970-0.988 indicate non-affine residuals in the fit sample set.
limits: This explains why reverse models need not invert forward models; it does not prove which decoder/development stage caused the non-affine residuals or justify loosening acceptance. No confirmed arithmetic or inverse-transform bug identified.

focused_validation.scope: Synthetic photometric policy, HDR/alpha preservation, inverse/reflected transforms, cancellation and fit failures; not real-camera acceptance.
